docs/design/nan-retirement.md: Providers can opt into a loopback-only `noSniRoute` for a valid ClientHello without SNI. Unknown SNI and malformed TLS remain closed. The recovery Caddy front has a public IP certificate and serves only the configured recovery/control paths; arbitrary destinations are not accepted. Provider-local routes carry `api.enclavehost.eth` and `mcp.enclavehost.eth` to the migrated control TLS service. Public native metadata is implemented in `relay/native-discovery.mjs`; no application signing key or credential is exposed there.
